summary: We identified multiple strong-value used‑SUV candidates (model year ≥ 2020, mileage ≤ 40 k when possible) around Philadelphia and nearby southeastern PA/South Jersey. Notable options include a 2022 Subaru Forester Premium (~10.7 k miles, ~$25.1 k), a 2022 Subaru Forester Base (~67 k miles, ~$18.8 k), and a 2022 Toyota RAV4 LE (~50 k miles, ~$24.99 k). All listings include dealer fees; confirm vehicle history and remaining unseen fees. Hybrids not included due to lack of compelling evidence in these specific listings.

trimComparisons.comparison: The Premium adds features like Sunroof/Moonroof, Heated Front Seats, Adaptive Cruise, Apple CarPlay/Android Auto, Blind‑Spot and more, whereas the Base is a more stripped version but still retains AWD and reliable mechanics—Premium commands a price premium but offers substantially more comfort and tech.
